text:
It was a very hot summer. A crow flew for hours and hours. She was very thirsty.

She saw a pitcher near a house. “Maybe there is water inside!” she thought.

She looked in. There was a little water, but it was at the bottom. The crow put her beak in, but she could not reach it.

She tried to push the pitcher, but it was too heavy. She tried to break it, but it was too strong. The crow was tired and sad.

Then she had an idea. She saw small stones on the ground. She took one stone and dropped it into the pitcher. The water went up a little bit.

She took another stone and dropped it in. The water went up again. She brought more and more stones. One by one, the water came higher.

At last, the water was near the top. The crow drank it all. She was happy.

Moral: When you think carefully, you can solve any problem.

quiz.q: The crow broke the pitcher to get the water.
The story happens in a very hot summer.
How did the crow make the water go up?
o: She dropped stones into the pitcher
